answer: Require every agent to stake tokens that are slashed on proven fraud, and to earn trust only through a verifiable history of completed work recorded in a public atlas of attestations. Like a vine that grows one verified link at a time, reputation spreads from trusted introducers, but each new identity starts on the lowest terrace with tiny limits. Creating thousands of fake identities then costs real stake and real completed work per identity, so a Sybil flood becomes expensive while honest newcomers can still climb gradually.
